service.description: A knowledge source of an organization (design KnowledgeSources ServiceKnowledgeSources) from its date: a wiki space the user may read (SPACE_UNAVAILABLE), or the part of it under pagePathPrefix; its audience (SkaInternal, SkaCustomer, SkaPublic: AUDIENCE_INVALID; never internal in a space with a public address: INTERNAL_PUBLIC_SPACE), the language of its pages (LANGUAGE_REQUIRED), the queue (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE) or product category it is first for, its priority, whether it is suggested, its review team (a team of the organization: TEAM_UNAVAILABLE) and the draft space for articles from cases. A save of an existing source (serviceKnowledgeSourceId) or of the same space and path ends the row it replaces; with end, ends it. Wiki spaces only, and a source never widens who may read a page. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

The articles of an organization's knowledge sources that a subject matches (text, else the case's subject), the requester's language first (localeLanguage, else the case's contact's or customer's user locale), then the sources for the case's queue or the product category, the words matched and the source's priority. With requestId the case must be of the user's organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). On an agent's surface (the default) the organization must be the user's, and a page is offered only when the wiki lets the user view it, drafts and internal articles flagged; with customerVisible only published, unrestricted pages of customer and public sources, never an internal article. No permission: it shows nothing the wiki does not.

A published article (F59) by the exact-published-version rule of the forum's site pages: the text of the page's published version (get#PublishedWikiPageText with no version asked, its answer checked against the page's published version), cleaned. On a customer-visible surface (the default, for the Support app) only a page of a current customer or public source (of organizationPartyId when given), not restricted; for an agent (customerVisible false) a page of the user's organizations' sources the wiki lets them view. A draft, an internal article and a page in no source are unavailable alike (ARTICLE_UNAVAILABLE), whatever the address guessed.

The published address of an article an agent sends a customer (Send to customer): a published, unrestricted page of a customer or public source of the user's organizations, at its space's publicPageUrl (the Support app's CustomerArticle once it is built), made absolute on this server when the space's is relative. Refuses a draft (ARTICLE_NOT_PUBLISHED), an internal article or one in no source (ARTICLE_INTERNAL), a space with no public address (NO_PUBLIC_URL), a page the user may not view and, with requestId, a case not of the user's organization.

An agent's report on an article read for a case: helpful or not (HELPFUL_REQUIRED) and a plain-text comment (markup dropped), on the version given or the published one, for the organization of the article's source. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, with requestId a case of the user's organization, and a page of its sources the wiki lets the user view (ARTICLE_UNAVAILABLE). The Support app's customer rating (P15) records the same record.

The review of article feedback (design ArticleFeedback FeedbackReview): a decision for each feedback given (AfdImprove makes one task per article for the assignee given or the source's review team, or links the task given; AfdNoChange and AfdDismissed take none), each in its own transaction, so one of another organization (Forbidden), one reviewed already (AlreadyReviewed) or one that fails is named in results and the others are reviewed. The article is never changed. Needs SUPPORT_KNOWLEDGE_EDIT; with operationKey a retry answers the first result.

Internal to review#ArticleFeedback, which runs it in a transaction of its own per feedback: the feedback refused when of another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or reviewed already (ALREADY_REVIEWED); for AfdImprove the task given linked to its page, else one made (the batch's comments in it); the feedback reviewed. Needs SUPPORT_KNOWLEDGE_EDIT.

Internal, for review#ArticleFeedback and suggest#ArticleEdit, which check the permission: a task on a page (WikiPageWorkEffort) for an assignee (a review team), with the case it came from (RequestWorkEffort).

Suggest edit (F15) by an agent who may not edit the page: a task on the article for its source's review team with what should change (NOTE_REQUIRED), linked to the case when given. An editor instead saves a draft version and asks for its review (org.moqui.impl.WikiServices.request#WikiPageReview, Commons Knowledge's Request review). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and a page of the user's organizations' sources the wiki lets them view (ARTICLE_UNAVAILABLE).

A draft article from a case (design CaseToArticle ArticleDraft) in a draft space of the case's organization's knowledge sources: the title and text given, or the text of the outward and customer messages chosen (communicationEventIds: an email of the service desk to the customer or contact, or theirs; a note, or an email among staff or to anyone else, is internal and refused: INTERNAL_MESSAGE), with the case's personal data (the names, ids, email addresses, phone numbers and street addresses of its parties outside the service desk and of its emails' senders and recipients, the records it is linked to but its products, the customer's orders, returns and invoices, and anything shaped like an email address or phone number) replaced; a new page, unpublished, linked to the case by WikiPageRequest, and left to Commons' review and publication. With preview, the redacted text and what was taken out, nothing written. Needs SUPPORT_KNOWLEDGE_EDIT, the case of the user's organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a draft space the user may add pages to (SPACE_UNAVAILABLE); refuses a page already at the path (PAGE_EXISTS).
